body:
S1c and S1t are both posted for your signoff.
STORY-2903: S1c design note. The shared merge boundary is an architecture change, so I am holding code until you sign. One boundary, gate::landing_merge::merge, becomes the only production caller of merge_change (enforced by a ratchet); ship, drain, burndown, release and train move onto it. At the merge it re-checks: policy from the fetched default branch, floor/grant, advisor-or-operator merger in review-gated mode, and C2. Drain and burndown skip the CI wait in review-gated mode; release keeps it. land run gets a Ship action for an authorized caller in review-gated mode.
OPEN QUESTION: in review-gated mode, does pr ship merge a cleanly mergeable behind-base head directly, or refuse it?
STORY-2905: S1t sketch. The land loop is the single merge hand; auto-train stands down in review-gated mode. A per-PR claim, in the same lock domain as STORY-2902's boundary, fixes the #4270 race in both modes. Per-car train authority goes through the S1c boundary, including a grant that lapses mid-train. merger, use_train and C2 stay internal.
QUESTIONS: should the claim store be host-local or kept on the forge, and is stand-down acceptable for auto-train?
subject: S1c design note + S1t sketch posted for signoff (STORY-2903, STORY-2905)
